# Bond-OpenAI

## What it is

Bond-OpenAI is a local, provider-neutral MCP server that gives software agents safe telephone action capabilities. Clone the repository, bootstrap once, connect the MCP, and let Bond, Codex, or other MCP-compatible agents complete consented phone tasks.

The MCP runs locally and provides classify, create, status check, and cancel tools. Fredo is the default telephony executor (using Twilio for PSTN and Deepgram for hosted speech processing).

## Stack

- Python with uv for dependency management
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) server implementation
- Twilio (PSTN access, verified caller)
- Deepgram (hosted speech recognition, dialogue, TTS)

## Key directories

- `src/bond_mcp/` — MCP server, CLI, models, policy, providers
- `src/fredo/` — telephony runtime, voice agent, security
- `docs/` — setup guides (MCP.md, TELEPHONY.md, DEMO-RELAY.md, ENV.md, SMOKE.md)
- `codex-plugin/` — Codex plugin with fredo-call skill
- `demo/` — zero-credential demo profile for testing
- `scripts/` — bootstrap and setup utilities

## How to run

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Caezarr/Bond-OpenAI.git
cd Bond-OpenAI
./scripts/bootstrap.sh
uv run bond-mcp doctor
uv run bond-mcp serve
```

First run installs pinned dependencies and local tools. Provider credentials stay in an ignored `.env` for local mode or use `demo/profile.json` for zero-credential demo relay.

## Safety by default

- Explicit consent required
- E.164 destinations and exact allowlisting enforced
- Only verified caller identity used
- Human confirmation before dialing
- One active call, 180-second hard cap
- Recording disabled
- No credentials, raw audio, transcripts, or full phone numbers in logs
